author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: নিচের বিষয়ে একটি formal letter/application লেখো। নিজে লেখার পর checklist মিলিয়ে নমুনা উত্তর দেখো (Board: 10 marks)।

items.prompt: Write an application to the Headmaster of your school for a full free studentship.
items.model:
The Headmaster
[Name of School]
[Place]

Subject: Prayer for a full free studentship.

Sir,
With due respect, I beg to state that I am a regular student of class XII in your school. I always stand first in my class. But my father is a poor farmer. He cannot bear the expenses of my education along with the family.

In these circumstances, I therefore pray and hope that you would be kind enough to grant me a full free studentship and oblige thereby.

I remain,
Sir,
Your most obedient student,
Abdul Karim
Roll No. 01, Class XII
rubric: উপরে receiver (Headmaster) ও subject line সঠিকভাবে লিখেছি
'Sir,' দিয়ে শুরু এবং বিনয়ী ভাষা ব্যবহার করেছি
নিচে 'Your most obedient student' সহ নাম, roll ও class দিয়েছি

items.prompt: Write an email to your friend inviting him to visit your village. (Formal email format)
items.model:
To: rahat@example.com
Subject: Invitation to visit my village

Dear Rahat,

How are you? I hope you are doing well. I am writing to invite you to visit my village during the coming vacation.

My village is a beautiful place with green fields, a calm river and friendly people. We can enjoy fishing, walk along the riverbank and taste fresh village food. I am sure you will love it.

Please let me know if you can come. I am eagerly waiting for your reply.

Best wishes,
Abdul Karim
rubric: গ্রামের আকর্ষণ ও আমন্ত্রণ স্পষ্টভাবে লিখেছি
'Best wishes/Yours' সহ নাম দিয়ে শেষ করেছি
